A few patterned eggs are partially hidden naturally in clover along a winding trail of small round golden ether droplets. A large elegant patterned egg opens slightly with soft gold light, suggesting a treasure collection. Warm fresh daylight, emerald/mint, coral and honey-gold palette. Focus on exploration and charming egg treasures, no dark purple drapes, no religious symbols.
